newsitem.title: USA: ASM International NV Q3 net shr drops.
newsitem.headline: ASM International NV Q3 net shr drops.

text.p: (All data above 000s in Dutch guilders except per share numbers)

NOTE - Q3 1996 results in U.S. dollars were net income of $3.9 million, or $0.12 per share, on revenues of $73.9 million. For the first nine months of 1996, the company reported net income of $35.7 million, or $1.06, on revenues of $290.1 million. Results from the previous year were not available in U.S. dollars. The U.S. figures are based on an exchange rate of 1.7148 Dutch guilders to the dollar.
The company said Q3 1996 results reflected the cancellation of a large order from a U.S. manufacturer for one of the company's wafer-processing equipment products.
